description:
Umbrella epic to ratify the JMAP-6r7c review-pass recommendations that all conclude with 'land in a coordinated 0.2.0 minor bump'. Workspace AGENTS.md says 'Prefer non-breaking changes. Reshape only when the workspace is bumping a major.' This umbrella collects every public-API-breaking reshape on jmap-base-client identified by JMAP-6r7c so they land in a single coordinated version cut rather than three sequential minor bumps.

Workspace-coordination context: workspace Cargo.toml lines 55-59 anchors the workspace-wide 0.2 bump to four prereq beads (JMAP-g7wu.1 CallerCtx, JMAP-g7wu.3 helpers builder, JMAP-g7wu.9 UTCDate, JMAP-r3pg.14 extract_account_id) which all closed in early May 2026. The workspace-wide 0.2.0 bump is therefore unblocked at the prereq level; this epic collects the jmap-base-client-specific breaking changes that should ride along.

Scope (one bullet per bundled bead, all children of this epic):
- JMAP-6r7c.20 — AuthProvider::auth_header signature locks header into single static pair (api-contract, P2)
- JMAP-6r7c.26 — ClientError::Parse and Serialize variants expose serde_json::Error publicly (api-contract, P2)
- JMAP-6r7c.31 — WsSession provides no concurrent-send safety (api-contract, P2)
- JMAP-6r7c.36 — TransportConfig::build_client returns concrete reqwest::Client (api-contract leak, P2)
- JMAP-6r7c.48 — DownloadBlobParams.expected_sha256 is Option<&str>, not Option<&Sha256> (type-design, P1)
- JMAP-6r7c.50 — upload_blob takes four positional &str args; introduce UploadBlobParams (type-design, P1)
- JMAP-6r7c.40 — Session URLs lack typed wrapper distinguishing template vs plain (api-contract defensive, P4)
- JMAP-6r7c.43 — BlobUploadResponse PartialEq/Eq + extra Map ordering dependency (api-contract leak, P4)
- JMAP-6r7c.62 — AuthProvider::auth_header returns (&str, &str) without secret-typing (crypto-security, P3)
- JMAP-6r7c.63 — Username/AccountName newtypes with redacting Display (P3)
- JMAP-6r7c.64 — Add Session-taking variants of upload_blob and download_blob (P3)
- JMAP-6r7c.65 — Builder API for CustomCaTransport: multi-root, intermediates, mTLS (P3)

Out of scope:
- jmap-types changes (covered by JMAP-6xs8.3 and its umbrella) — coordinate the version bump but not the API reshape here
- Sibling extension client crates (jmap-mail-client, jmap-chat-client) — workspace canonical-template rules require propagation only AFTER jmap-base-client bumps; file a propagation sweep bead at that time

Sequencing:
1. Land .20 + .26 + .31 + .36 (api-contract reshapes — trait/error signatures)
2. Land .48 + .50 (type-design — blob params)
3. Land .40 + .43 (defensive shape fixes)
4. Land .62 + .63 + .64 + .65 (new API surface — additive but rides the bump)
5. Bump jmap-base-client Cargo.toml to 0.2.0
6. CHANGELOG entry covering all bundled changes
7. File propagation sweep beads for sibling *-client crates

This epic does NOT authorize the workspace-wide 0.2.0 bump on its own. Bumping jmap-base-client to 0.2.0 alone is asymmetric with the planned coordinated bump (workspace Cargo.toml comment lines 55-59) and may need workspace-architectural decision before publish. Filing this as 'human' so the maintainer can pick the timing: (a) ride the next coordinated bump, or (b) cut jmap-base-client 0.2.0 ahead of the workspace bump if the workspace bump is far off.

Recommendation: option (a). The workspace-wide coordinated bump is the AGENTS.md-aligned timing and the prereq beads have all closed, so the coordinated cut is likely near-term. Holding this jmap-base-client umbrella as a ready-to-execute work batch that lands when the coordinated cut is scheduled minimises churn.
